prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the general laws of rigid body mechanics and their application to engineering problems.

learning_outcomes.text: Identify and quantify the different types of efforts, stresses, and deformations.
Dimension and check simple mechanical elements.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of Elasticity. Failure criteria
Simple efforts: stresses, deformations and diagrams.
Combined efforts: stresses, deformations and diagrams.

assessment_methods.method: Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation - Ordinary Call)
Continuous Evaluation (Lab practices and controls) (Continuous Evaluation - Ordinary Call)
Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation - Extraordinary Calls)
Half of Continuous Evaluation grade (Lab practices, Controls) (Continuous Evaluation - Extraordinary Calls)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Evaluation in the Ordinary Call, the final grade is calculated as 0.80 * Exam Grade (out of 10) + Continuous Evaluation Grade, where Continuous Evaluation (PLs and controls) accounts for 20%. For Continuous Evaluation in Extraordinary Calls, the final grade is 0.90 * Exam Grade (out of 10) + 0.50 * Continuous Evaluation Grade, with the exam accounting for 90%. Differentiated Evaluation consists solely of a 100% written theoretical-practical exam.
